## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Verification

- Automated checks and results from `node build.mjs && node --test`
- CI on the latest revision, when configured
- Manual or integration results, including the revision and environment

## Manual testing

**Needed:** Yes / No. Explain why.

If needed, give prerequisites, exact test data, steps with expected results,
pass/fail criteria, evidence to record, cleanup, and execution status. A link to
a maintained procedure is fine. Omit API keys and private listening data.

## Deployment and recovery

Describe how readers receive the change, any configuration or database
migration, and how to recover. This project runs locally by default.

## Remaining work

Record unverified checks or follow-up work. Link related issues or dependencies.
Use a closing reference only if merging should close the issue.
